hf.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
hf.abstract: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception. In this report, we present WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), a powerful VLM that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception through structured next-token prediction. It supports multiple visual tasks including object detection, referring localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting, enabling localization at any user-specific granularity, from points and boxes to masks and alpha mattes. Architecturally, we integrate a lightweight pixel decoder into the VLM via a special <OBJ> token to generate instance-level pixel outputs. We train the model with a three-stage curriculum SFT followed by mixed-task RL. Across over 30 benchmarks, WeVisOne-VL demonstrates leading performance on both object-level and pixel-level tasks, while maintaining robust rejection for object-absent queries. By releasing WeVisOne-VL to the open-source community, we hope to advance VLMs from broad visual understanding toward truly reliable perception systems for real-world deployment.
hf.titleZh: WeVisOne-VL:从物体到像素的统一视觉感知
hf.summaryZh: 针对现有VLM在细粒度视觉感知上不可靠的问题，把物体级与像素级感知统一进结构化next-token预测，覆盖检测、指代定位、计数、OCR、分割与matting，支持从点、框到mask与alpha matte的任意粒度定位;架构上用特殊<OBJ>token把轻量像素解码器接入VLM以输出实例级像素结果，训练采用三阶段课程式SFT加混合任务RL;在30余个基准上于物体级与像素级任务均取得领先，并对目标缺失查询保持稳健拒答。该方法适合需要精细定位与分割输出的真实部署感知系统。
hf.reason: VLM细粒度感知统一架构加混合任务RL，命中多模态与后训练方向

hf.title: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
hf.abstract: Cinematic video generation requires both temporal inference from limited inputs (i.e., sparse rather than frame-by-frame guidance) and factor-aware control of character, scene, action, and camera. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer useful priors for both capabilities, but their representations are not automatically actionable for video generation: a Video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) may bypass them through native conditioning pathways, and using them does not ensure either factor-aware control or generation-compatible temporal prediction. We propose Factor-Aware Predictive Learning (FAPL), which establishes effective MLLM latent use as a shared prerequisite and then targets the two capabilities with complementary learning signals. First, latent-only generator grounding trains the DiT with a frozen MLLM and connector, strengthening the DiT's use of MLLM latents for generation. Second, for factor-aware control, paired videos specify a target-factor change and non-target preservation, and factor-span replacement trains the DiT to realize this relationship in its output. Third, for temporal inference, text-only and text-plus-complete-video observations share a video target, and the trained DiT is then frozen while the MLLM and connector are optimized through it. This final stage trains limited-input representations for generation while retaining complete-observation reconstruction as a complementary training mode. Extensive experiments demonstrate our consistently better performance on three cinematic video generation tasks (i.e., sparse-to-video, factor-aware editing, and multi-shot generation) over baselines and validate FAPL's contributions to MLLM feature use, temporal control, and factor coordination.
hf.titleZh: 让 MLLM 潜表示真正起作用:面向电影级视频生成的因子感知预测学习
hf.summaryZh: 电影级视频生成既要处理稀疏输入下的时序推断，又要对人物、场景、动作、镜头做因子级控制。方法把「让 DiT 真正用上 MLLM 潜表示」当作共同前提:先用冻结的 MLLM 与 connector 做 latent-only 的生成器接地训练;再用配对视频定义目标因子改变与非目标保持，通过 factor-span replacement 训练因子控制;最后冻结 DiT、经由它反传优化 MLLM 与 connector，使稀疏观测与完整视频观测共享同一视频目标。在稀疏到视频、因子感知编辑、多镜头生成三项任务上均优于基线，并验证了 MLLM 特征利用、时序控制与因子协调各自的贡献。
hf.reason: 核心是视频生成与 DiT 条件控制，属低分方向，仅 MLLM 表示利用略沾边

hf.title: Deep Search in Real-World Web Environments
hf.abstract: Despite substantial progress in Deep Search agents, their ability to conduct end-to-end research in real-world open Web environments remains insufficiently evaluated. Unlike static retrieval settings, information on the real-world Web is distributed across diverse sources, modalities, and heterogeneous formats, often involving complex interaction mechanisms that require agents to autonomously search for, access, and integrate relevant evidence during execution. To address this gap, we introduce the OpenDS task, designed to evaluate agents' ability to perform multi-step deep search in the live, open Web. This task requires agents to autonomously explore the real Web, discover and connect relevant evidence from multiple independent sources through Web search, browser interaction, and evidence processing, and ultimately determine a unique factual answer. Building on this task formulation, we construct OpenDS-World, a benchmark comprising 200 challenging tasks spanning diverse information modalities, heterogeneous file formats, and interactive access requirements, with independent human verification to ensure evidence validity and answer uniqueness. We evaluate 12 frontier models under a unified tool environment and execution protocol. The best-performing model achieves 39.0% accuracy, while human evaluation across 1,000 independent attempts yields 21.1% accuracy. Further analyses of tool usage, search cost, termination behavior, and failure recovery reveal substantial differences in research strategies across models, as well as persistent challenges in tool coordination and long-horizon search management. OpenDS-World provides a unified evaluation platform for systematically assessing and advancing agents' autonomous deep search capabilities in real-world open Web environments.
hf.titleZh: 真实网络环境中的深度搜索
hf.summaryZh: 深度搜索 Agent 在真实开放网络中的端到端研究能力一直缺乏系统评测：真实网络的信息分散在多种来源、模态与异构格式中，且需要复杂交互才能获取。为此提出 OpenDS 任务，要求 Agent 自主完成网络搜索、浏览器交互与证据处理，从多个独立来源串联证据并给出唯一事实答案；并构建 OpenDS-World 基准，包含 200 道覆盖多模态内容、异构文件格式与交互访问要求的难题，且每题都经人工独立核验，确保证据有效、答案唯一。在统一工具环境与执行协议下评测 12 个前沿模型，最佳模型准确率为 39.0%，而人类在 1000 次独立尝试中的准确率为 21.1%。对工具使用、搜索成本、终止行为与失败恢复的分析显示，各模型的研究策略差异显著，长程搜索管理与工具协调仍是持续挑战。
hf.reason: 真实开放 Web 深度搜索 Agent 基准，属 Agent 与评测方向的扎实工作

hf.title: Editing Images into Reusable Layers via Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation
hf.abstract: High-quality image editing requires precise modification of target regions while preserving the content of unrelated regions. Existing editing models produce flattened outputs that limit precise local manipulation and layer reuse, while decomposition methods typically optimize layer recovery separately from instruction-driven editing. To this end, we introduce LayerEditor, a unified framework that couples instruction-guided image editing with controllable generation of reusable RGBA layers. At its core, In-Context RGB-Alpha Token Modeling jointly represents the edited canvas and an ordered sequence of RGB-Alpha layers within a single token sequence, enabling semantic edits and explicit control over individual layer content. To retain the pretrained model's editing capability during adaptation to layered outputs, we propose Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation, which transfers its editing prior to both the edited canvas and the image composed from the predicted layers. To support training and evaluation, we construct LayerEditor-100K, a large-scale paired image-editing dataset with ordered RGBA layer annotations, and introduce dedicated benchmarks for layered editing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LayerEditor maintains strong editing fidelity while generating accurate RGBA layers, supporting both flexible layer-level manipulation and multi-layer decomposition.
hf.titleZh: 通过组合式编辑先验蒸馏把图像编辑为可复用图层
hf.summaryZh: 现有图像编辑模型只输出展平图像，难以进行局部精细操作与图层复用，而分解方法又把图层恢复与指令编辑分开优化。LayerEditor 用 In-Context RGB-Alpha Token Modeling 把编辑画布与有序 RGBA 图层序列放进同一个 token 序列，统一支持语义编辑与图层内容控制;再用 Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation 把预训练模型的编辑先验同时迁移到编辑画布与图层合成图像上。工作还构建了带有序 RGBA 图层标注的 LayerEditor-100K 数据集与配套 benchmark，实验表明其在保持编辑保真度的同时生成准确 RGBA 图层，支持图层级操作与多层分解。
hf.reason: 图像编辑与图层生成，属视觉生成方向，与关注方向无关

hf.title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
hf.abstract: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated). IQuest-Q1 is developed through a three-stage process: (1) stable and efficient pre-training, combining Stable SplitNorm, Muon, and muP with a two-stage curriculum whose second stage increases the coding-data mixture, preserving a wide stability margin between safe and optimal learning rates; (2) fine-grained mid-training, expanding the data mixture across domains and formats and progressively extending the context; and (3) multi-scaffold with multi-version post-training, combining SFT, domain-specialized RL, and MOPD across various scaffolds to integrate complementary training signals and strengthen agentic coding capabilities. Furthermore, model merging combines different experts and checkpoints from different stages while mitigating conflicts among their parameter updates. The resulting IQuest-Q1 demonstrates capabilities in both coding and general tasks. We release IQuest-Q1 as an open-source model to support community research and development.
hf.titleZh: IQuest-Q1：提升 Agentic CLI 系统的基础能力
hf.summaryZh: 面向命令行智能体（CLI Agent）场景，发布 320B 总参数、15B 激活的稀疏 MoE 基础模型。训练分三阶段：预训练结合 Stable SplitNorm、Muon 与 muP，并采用两阶段课程学习，第二阶段提高代码数据配比，在安全与最优学习率之间保留较大稳定余量；中期训练跨领域、跨格式扩展数据并渐进延长上下文；后训练采用多 scaffold、多版本策略，融合 SFT、领域 RL 与 MOPD，并通过模型合并整合不同专家与各阶段 checkpoint、缓解参数更新冲突。模型以开源形式发布，兼顾代码与通用任务能力。
hf.reason: MoE 基础模型三阶段训练报告，含 Agentic 编码与 RL 后训练，命中核心方向

hf.title: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
hf.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. Recent digital agents test this idea by rewriting their own code and checking each version with executable tests. Bringing these mechanisms into the physical world requires learning from partial observations through costly trials, while accounting for changing operating conditions and potentially irreversible consequences. We position RSI within robot learning and trace pathways from improving robot capabilities to improving the processes that generate them. We examine how physical experience can strengthen these improvement mechanisms and when the resulting gains can support further self-improvement of the mechanisms themselves. Gains carry forward only when feedback addresses remaining learning needs, the receiving component can use the change, its value survives changes in tasks or hardware, and continued practice remains safe and affordable. Existing studies, concentrated in manipulation, support behavioral improvement, benefits to later learning, and procedure improvement. Some systems also change the improver's knowledge or tools, but the physical studies reviewed here have yet to isolate gains attributable to recursion. We synthesize these findings into evaluation principles and research directions for machines that, trial by trial, safely improve the way they improve.
hf.titleZh: 迈向物理 AI 的递归自我改进
hf.summaryZh: 面向物理世界中的递归自我改进（RSI），即系统不仅改进行为，还改进产生改进的机制本身。文章把 RSI 定位到机器人学习，梳理从提升机器人能力到改进其生成过程的技术路径，并给出继续自改进收益成立的四项条件：反馈须覆盖剩余学习需求、接收组件能利用该改动、其价值在任务或硬件变化后仍成立、持续练习安全且可负担。综述现有操纵类研究，发现已能支持行为改进、增益后续学习与流程改进，但尚无研究能分离出递归本身的贡献。
hf.reason: 机器人学习综述，属具身智能低分方向

hf.title: Deep Fusion Memory: A Chunk-Level Parametric Memory for Large Language Models
hf.abstract: Large language models need effective ways to acquire and use external knowledge beyond what they retain from pretraining. Continued pretraining risks catastrophic forgetting, while retrieval at inference time can add substantial overhead. External parametric memory avoids online retrieval, but constructing its training data requires extensive offline search, and output-level interpolation provides only shallow fusion. We introduce Deep Fusion Memory (DFM), a parametric memory architecture that reduces this construction workload and incorporates learned memory into intermediate hidden states. A causal memory predictor learns to generate memory from the preceding context, using retrieved chunk embeddings from the corpus as supervision. The predicted memory is shared across tokens within each chunk and fused into their hidden states through gated cross-attention. Memory prediction and fusion are trained end to end with the backbone frozen, and inference requires no explicit retrieval. Compared with existing parametric memory approaches, which often construct token-level memory targets, DFM requires 32times fewer retrieval queries and 2048times fewer retrieved items to construct its training data. Across six QA tasks, DFM performs better over the strongest baseline by 12.71% on Mistral-7B-v0.3 and 11.19% on Qwen3-8B-Base. Beyond QA, domain adaptation yields average gains of 6.51 and 4.38 points over Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base, respectively.
hf.titleZh: Deep Fusion Memory：面向大语言模型的分块级参数化记忆
hf.summaryZh: 解决大模型引入外部知识的两难：继续预训练会灾难性遗忘，推理时检索开销大，而现有参数化记忆构建训练数据需大量离线搜索、且仅在输出层做浅层插值融合。DFM 用因果记忆预测器从上下文生成记忆，以语料中检索到的 chunk embedding 作为监督，块内 token 共享同一记忆，并通过门控 cross-attention 注入其隐状态；记忆预测与融合在冻结主干下端到端训练，推理时无需显式检索。构建训练数据所需的检索查询减少32倍、检索条目减少2048倍，在六个 QA 任务上分别比最强基线高12.71%（Mistral-7B-v0.3）与11.19%（Qwen3-8B-Base），领域适配在 Qwen3-4B-Base与Qwen3-8B-Base上平均提升6.51与4.38分。
hf.reason: 参数化记忆注入中间隐状态，属架构与记忆方向扎实工作

hf.title: What Generation Knows: Unlocking Fine-Grained Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models
hf.abstract: Fine-grained visual understanding requires distinguishing subtle differences in local attributes and spatial relations, yet remains challenging for existing vision-language models. Unified multimodal models (UMMs) offer a new opportunity through generation pathways that preserve rich visual information complementary to understanding. However, existing generation-assisted understanding methods mainly rely on generative supervision or explicit generation and have not systematically explored direct use of native generation-side representations. To address this gap, we systematically analyze what generation-side representations offer for fine-grained understanding, finding that they are more sensitive to fine-grained semantic changes, capture task-relevant changes missed by understanding-side representations, and depend on correct spatial organization for this advantage. Guided by these findings, we design GAFU, a post-training framework that unlocks native generation-side information for fine-grained understanding. It compresses generation-side visual representations into compact \(G\) tokens that preserve fine-grained visual details, enabling task-conditioned retrieval by the understanding pathway. Experiments show that GAFU consistently outperforms SFT baselines trained on the same data across diverse visual understanding tasks and UMM architectures, with maximum relative improvements of 20.00\%, 17.94\%, and 8.62\% on VStar-Bench, OmniSpatial, and VSR-Bench, respectively. Overall, GAFU converts complementary information from the generation pathway into gains in fine-grained visual understanding, providing an effective path toward synergy between generation and understanding in UMMs.
hf.titleZh: 生成所知：释放统一多模态模型中的细粒度理解
hf.summaryZh: 细粒度视觉理解需区分局部属性与空间关系的细微差异，现有视觉语言模型仍难做到；统一多模态模型的生成通路保留理解侧缺失的视觉信息，但此前方法多依赖生成监督或显式生成，未直接利用原生生成侧表示。系统分析发现生成侧表示对细粒度语义变化更敏感、能捕捉理解侧漏掉的任务相关变化，且该优势依赖正确的空间组织。据此提出后训练框架GAFU，将生成侧表示压缩为紧凑G token供理解通路做任务条件检索。在VStar-Bench、OmniSpatial、VSR-Bench上相对同数据SFT基线最大相对提升20.00%、17.94%、8.62%，跨多种UMM架构一致有效。
hf.reason: 统一多模态模型生成侧表示用于细粒度理解，属MLLM训练方向

hf.title: LaLa-World: Scaling Latent World Models with Natural Language Actions
hf.abstract: This paper shows that JEPA-style latent world models (LWMs) can learn across diverse domains and data sources by adopting the language-conditioned interface of video generation models. We establish this approach as an effective and efficient basis for planning with imagination and downstream policy fine-tuning. To this end, we introduce LaLa-World, a Language-conditioned Latent World model that learns from simulation and robot trajectories together with broader image and video data. Two designs make this work. First, we describe both numerical actions and visual changes in language, enabling joint training of a single future predictor across heterogeneous datasets. Second, we build the predictor on a language model, allowing it to interpret language conditions while predicting future latent states. The resulting predictor achieves higher average MPC planning performance than existing LWMs trained separately for each domain or task. Adding image and video data further improves average planning performance and robustness to action phrasing. In a matched comparison with an RAEv2-based video generation model baseline, LaLa-World reaches comparable planning performance with 6times less training cost and 13.9times faster planning. Beyond planning, the pretrained LaLa-World serves as an initialization for LaLa-Policy, which jointly predicts actions and future visual representations. LaLa-Policy performs competitively with Cosmos Policy on LIBERO and RoboCasa, with up to 5.5times faster inference.
hf.titleZh: LaLa-World:以自然语言动作为接口扩展潜空间世界模型
hf.summaryZh: 面向跨域数据难以联合训练的问题，将数值动作与视觉变化统一用自然语言描述，使单个未来预测器可在仿真、机器人轨迹及通用图像视频数据上联合训练。预测器以语言模型为骨干，既能解读语言条件又能预测未来潜状态。在MPC规划中平均性能超过按域单独训练的潜世界模型，加入图像视频数据还能提升对动作措辞变化的鲁棒性;与基于RAEv2的视频生成基线相比，训练成本降低6倍、规划速度提升13.9倍且性能相当。预训练模型可作为LaLa-Policy的初始化，在LIBERO与RoboCasa上接近Cosmos Policy，推理最快提升5.5倍。
hf.reason: 机器人世界模型与策略学习，属具身智能低分方向

hf.title: Self-Distilling Future Video Representations for World Action Models
hf.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising approach to learning generalist robot policies using rich spatiotemporal priors from pre-trained video diffusion models. A recent line of WAMs improves inference efficiency by conditioning a separate action decoder on intermediate future video representations extracted from a single denoising step, avoiding costly iterative denoising required for video generation. This design makes action prediction depend directly on the quality of these future representations. In this paper, we introduce Future REpresentation learning via self-Distillation with temporal context (FRED), a framework that trains WAMs to improve the quality of future video representations from noise in a single denoising step. Specifically, FRED uses self-distillation to predict future representations from noise, using representations extracted from ground-truth future observations as targets. We further condition the video model on historical observations, providing temporal context for predicting future representations better. Across diverse real-world manipulation scenarios, FRED consistently outperforms competing WAMs. It achieves particularly large gains on long-horizon and out-of-domain tasks under zero-shot environment generalization, and substantially improves human-to-robot skill transfer, reaching 50.0% task success on tasks absent from robot training data and demonstrated only in human videos, compared with 19.4% for the best competing WAM.
hf.titleZh: 面向世界动作模型的自蒸馏未来视频表征
hf.summaryZh: 世界动作模型（WAM）借助预训练视频扩散模型的时空先验学习通用机器人策略，而依赖单步去噪所提取未来视频表征的动作解码器，其性能直接受这些表征质量制约。FRED 框架用自蒸馏方式从噪声中预测未来表征，以真实未来观测提取的表征为目标，并对视频模型以历史观测为条件提供时序上下文。在多种真实操作场景中一致优于同类 WAM，在零样本环境泛化的长程与域外任务上提升尤为显著；仅由人类视频示范、未出现在机器人训练数据中的任务成功率从最佳基线的 19.4% 提升到 50.0%。
hf.reason: 世界动作模型面向机器人操作，属具身智能低分方向

hf.title: FilmFlow: Agentic System for 3D Virtual Film Cinematography
hf.abstract: Complex camera motion is central to visual storytelling, yet translating cinematographic intent into controllable, executable camera trajectories remains challenging. We introduce FilmFlow, an agentic framework that converts natural-language instructions or reference videos into explicit camera trajectories for dynamic 3D environments. To generate these trajectories, a Director agent constructs executable camera plans by composing high-level motions from concurrent atomic operations that jointly control translation, rotation, and framing. The Director is supported by three specialized agents: an Interpreter that extracts scene-grounded cinematographic intent, a Scout that selects initial viewpoints, and a Critic that evaluates rendered results and provides visual feedback for iterative plan refinement. We also introduce CinemaBench, comprising 150 Blender scenes from self-created and licensed sources, with five camera instructions per scene for 750 text-directed tasks and 60 reference videos associated with a subset of scenes. CinemaBench supports evaluation of both text-directed camera generation and video reference-directed camera generation. Across a diverse set of evaluated baselines, FilmFlow achieves the strongest benchmark performance and the highest user preference, demonstrating effective spatial reasoning, temporal coordination, and visual composition for executable 3D cinematography.
hf.titleZh: FilmFlow:用于3D虚拟电影摄影的Agentic系统
hf.summaryZh: 把自然语言指令或参考视频转成动态3D场景中可执行的相机轨迹:由Director agent通过组合平移、旋转、构图等可并发的原子操作来搭建高层运镜方案，并由Interpreter(抽取与场景绑定的摄影意图)、Scout(挑选初始视角)、Critic(依据渲染结果给视觉反馈、驱动迭代修正)三个专门agent支撑。同时发布CinemaBench，含150个Blender场景、750条文本运镜任务与60段参考视频，覆盖文本指令与视频参考两种设定。FilmFlow在多种基线中取得最佳基准成绩与最高用户偏好，适用于虚拟制片与3D内容创作的自动化运镜。
hf.reason: 多智能体规划加视觉反馈闭环有新意，但属3D影视垂直应用

hf.title: Meta Expert: Cross-Layer Expert Sharing for Storage- and Retrieval-Efficient MoE
hf.abstract: As model parameters scale up, sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approaches have become essential for model scaling. However, mainstream models currently adopt hierarchical architectures, where experts in different layers, although topologically independent, exhibit substantial similarity and redundancy in their stored content. Compared to the hierarchically arranged Local Expert in existing mainstream models, we hypothesize that inter-layer shared Meta Expert hold greater potential. To this end, we conduct a multi-dimensional empirical comparison between Local and Meta Experts, and find that models incorporating Meta Experts exhibit lower parameter redundancy, together with lower cross-entropy loss and higher downstream task accuracy. With the activated quantity and the expert granularity held fixed, our model matches the performance of Vanilla MoE using only 70--80\% of the experts, substantially improving the model's scaling potential. Beyond removing inter-layer redundancy among experts and improving information storage efficiency, our theoretical analysis further shows that, compared with Local Experts, Meta Experts provide hidden states with more flexible residual pathways, thereby improving information retrieval efficiency.
hf.titleZh: Meta Expert：面向存储与检索高效 MoE 的跨层专家共享
hf.summaryZh: 针对主流分层 MoE 中不同层专家在存储内容上高度相似、冗余明显的问题，提出跨层共享的 Meta Expert 架构：在激活专家数量与专家粒度固定的前提下，用层间共享的元专家替代各层独立的 Local Expert，压缩专家参数的重复存储。先做多维实证对比，显示 Meta Expert 模型参数冗余更低、交叉熵损失更低、下游任务准确率更高；仅用 70–80% 的专家数量即可匹配 Vanilla MoE 的性能。理论分析进一步表明，Meta Expert 为隐状态提供了更灵活的残差通路，从而提升信息检索效率。
hf.reason: MoE 跨层专家共享新架构，兼有实证与理论分析，命中架构方向

hf.title: Policy-Mask: Budget-Aware Adaptation of Diffusion Features to Discriminative Tasks
hf.abstract: Selecting intermediate features from a frozen diffusion model for discriminative tasks is non-trivial because the useful signal is distributed across the denoising trajectory, network depth, and channels. In practice, this requires choosing a timestep, a block, and a channel subset. Existing methods either fix these choices by hand or optimize only a few extraction hyperparameters, most often the timestep, then reuse the same rule across inputs and budgets. We introduce Policy-Mask, a budget-conditioned policy trained on the downstream objective that jointly selects all three under a prescribed channel budget. Without normalization, the channel-score contribution grows with the number of selected channels and dominates the timestep and block updates. We normalize it by subset cardinality, keeping the three policy heads on comparable scales and stabilizing joint training. At matched budgets, Policy-Mask improves over fixed extraction and feature-filter baselines across segmentation, classification, and semantic correspondence, reaching 38.9 mIoU on ADE20K, 75.4% top-1 on CIFAR-100 at 128 dimensions, and 76.3 PCK@0.1 on SPair-71k. Component-wise ablations show that block selection materially affects downstream accuracy, and the highest recorded channel-budget score occurs at 256 retained channels, identifying a practical operating point for compact diffusion representations. We further adapt Policy-Mask to diffusion transformers, including PixArt-Σ and SD3.5 MMDiT, by replacing U-Net channels with image-token hidden dimensions.
hf.titleZh: Policy-Mask：面向判别任务的扩散特征预算感知适配
hf.summaryZh: 从冻结扩散模型中挑选中间特征用于判别任务时，有效信号分散在去噪轨迹、网络深度与通道三个维度上，现有做法多靠手工固定或只调时间步。Policy-Mask 训练一个以通道预算为条件的策略，在下游目标上联合选择时间步、block 与通道子集，并按子集基数归一化通道分数贡献，使三个策略头量级可比、联合训练稳定。在同等预算下，它在分割、分类与语义对应任务上优于固定抽取与特征筛选基线，ADE20K 达 38.9 mIoU、CIFAR-100 在 128 维下达 75.4% top-1、SPair-71k 达 76.3 PCK@0.1；消融显示 block 选择对精度影响显著，保留 256 通道为实用工作点，方法还可迁移到 PixArt-Σ 与 SD3.5 MMDiT 等扩散 Transformer。
hf.reason: 扩散模型特征复用于视觉判别任务，属低分扩散方向且与 LLM 无关

hf.title: Heartbeat Thinking: Speculative Reasoning and Tool Execution While Listening in Realtime Voice Agents
hf.abstract: Tool-using voice agents often leave users waiting after speech ends, even when actionable information arrives earlier in the request. Speculative approaches begin work during speech, but chunk-bounded or interrupt-on-update generation can truncate a tool call before its arguments are complete. This couples computation time to speech updates, limiting useful work completed in advance. We introduce Heartbeat Thinking, which handles updated input through new Thinker invocations while allowing ongoing invocations and dispatched tools to finish. Periodic invocations read the latest partial transcript and a shared record of completed reasoning and tool results. These results help resolve missing arguments and initiate dependent calls, allowing preparation to progress across speech updates. Across SpeechFCEval, FDBench v3, and AudioCRAG, Heartbeat improves aggregate speculative tool coverage or retrieval reuse over a SHANKS-style windowed baseline, with benchmark-dependent effects on final task quality. On FDBench v3, it increases tool coverage by 16 percentage points and reduces mean final-response latency by 36.4\%. The results show that heartbeat thinking paradigm preserving ongoing computation during speech can turn listening time into reusable preparation for faster and more capable voice-agent responses.
hf.titleZh: 心跳思考：实时语音 Agent 在聆听阶段进行投机推理与工具执行
hf.summaryZh: 实时语音 Agent 常在用户话音未落时闲置，等说完才开始调用工具，而现有的投机方案受分块边界限制，输入一更新就中断生成，容易把工具调用截断在参数尚未补全的阶段。Heartbeat Thinking 改为每次收到新的输入片段就新起一次 Thinker 调用，同时让仍在进行的推理与已派发的工具继续跑完，各次调用共享一份已完成推理与工具结果的公共记录，借它补齐缺失参数、发起有依赖关系的调用。在 SpeechFCEval、FDBench v3 与 AudioCRAG 上，其投机工具覆盖率与检索复用优于 SHANKS 式窗口基线；FDBench v3 上工具覆盖率提升 16 个百分点，最终响应平均延迟降低 36.4%，但最终任务质量的变化随基准而异。该方法把聆听时间转化为可复用的准备工作，适用于对首响应延迟敏感的语音工具 Agent。
hf.reason: 语音 Agent 的投机工具执行与延迟优化，机制有新意但属应用侧

hf.title: Code2Video-Compass: A Comprehensive Benchmark for General-Purpose Code-Based Video Generation across T2V, I2V, and V2V
hf.abstract: Code-based video generation offers fine-grained control, targeted editing, and component reuse compared with direct video generation. This approach requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to translate visual and temporal requirements into executable programs that produce complete videos. However, existing code-based benchmarks primarily target specialized tasks, leaving complete video creation across diverse creative categories and input modalities insufficiently evaluated. We introduce Code2Video-Compass, a general-purpose benchmark for code-based video generation across text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and video-to-video (V2V) settings. Code2Video-Compass comprises 2,104 tasks spanning 10 categories, 24 subtypes, and three complexity dimensions covering construction, dynamic animation, and state dependency. It combines tasks curated from textual instructions and visual references with corresponding T2V, I2V, and V2V tasks derived from complete professional and user-created videos. We propose a dual-level evaluation framework combining 12 objective metrics and five subjective metrics. Objective evaluation covers operational performance, video quality, text-video alignment, and reference fidelity, while subjective evaluation uses an MLLM judge to evaluate instruction following and holistic video quality. Extensive evaluation of 15 recent proprietary and open-weight MLLMs from nine families reveals that even leading models face challenges in reliably generating high-quality complete videos aligned with textual and visual requirements, with performance generally declining as construction, dynamic animation, and state-dependency complexity increases. We anticipate that Code2Video-Compass will advance reliable, coherent, and controllable code-based video generation and inspire broader progress in programmatic visual creation.
hf.titleZh: Code2Video-Compass:面向 T2V、I2V 与 V2V 的通用代码视频生成综合基准
hf.summaryZh: 代码视频生成要求 MLLM 把视觉与时序需求转写为可执行程序，以获得细粒度控制与组件复用，但已有基准多局限于专门任务，缺少跨类别与输入模态的完整评测。Code2Video-Compass 构建 2104 个任务，覆盖 10 大类、24 子类与三个复杂度维度，含从专业与用户视频派生的 T2V、I2V、V2V 任务，并用 12 项客观指标与 5 项 MLLM judge 主观指标做双层评测。对 9 个家族 15 个 MLLM 的评测显示，领先模型仍难稳定生成符合文本与视觉要求的高质量完整视频，性能随构建、动态动画与状态依赖复杂度上升而下降。
hf.reason: 面向视频生成的代码式基准，属低分方向，但含 MLLM 评测方法学成分

hf.title: RouteWeaver: Weaving Mode Selection and Execution into Unified LLM Routing
hf.abstract: LLM routing dynamically selects and coordinates heterogeneous language models across diverse tasks. However, existing approaches are largely built around a predefined execution paradigm, such as single-round, multi-round, or agentic routing, which fixes how model calls are organized and limits adaptation to different query needs. We propose RouteWeaver, a unified routing framework that integrates these routing modes within a single LLM policy, jointly learning which mode to use and how to select models within that mode. To jointly optimize mode selection and within-mode execution, we develop COMET-GRPO (COordinated Mode-Execution Training), which decouples the trajectory-level advantage into separate signals for mode selection and within-mode execution, enabling more targeted credit assignment to each decision level. We further introduce progressive exploration, which gradually shifts training from externally assigned modes to autonomous selection, so that the router first learns how to execute each mode before deciding when to use it. We evaluate RouteWeaver across mathematics, coding, knowledge, logical reasoning, and factual recall. RouteWeaver achieves an average accuracy of 61.4%, an 11.03% relative improvement over the strongest baseline, and outperforms all compared baselines in each of the five domains. Ablations show that both COMET-GRPO and progressive exploration are important for adaptive routing; without progressive exploration, the routing policy collapses entirely to single-round execution.
hf.titleZh: RouteWeaver：将模式选择与执行编织进统一的 LLM 路由
hf.summaryZh: 现有 LLM 路由被单轮、多轮或 agentic 等预定义执行范式锁死，难以适配不同查询需求。RouteWeaver 用单一 LLM 策略统一这些路由模式，联合学习“用哪种模式”与“模式内选哪个模型”；COMET-GRPO 把轨迹级优势拆成模式选择与模式内执行两路信号，实现分层信用分配，并配合渐进式探索，从外部指定模式逐步过渡到自主选择。在数学、代码、知识、逻辑推理与事实召回五类任务上平均准确率 61.4%，较最强基线相对提升 11.03%，五个域均领先；消融显示去掉渐进式探索后路由策略会完全坍缩为单轮执行。
hf.reason: LLM 路由 + GRPO 分层信用分配改进，命中后训练与 Agent 方向

hf.title: Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports
hf.abstract: Deep research agents synthesize open-web evidence into long reports, but current benchmarks do not evaluate research centered on a source video. We introduce Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation. Given a video and user request, an agent identifies research questions, retrieves external multimodal evidence, and produces an interactive report linked to relevant video moments. This task has direct practical value because it helps users locate relevant moments, verify claims, reproduce demonstrated procedures, and make informed decisions from video content. We present a skill-based workflow and OmniDR-Bench for this task. For evaluation, we propose Omni Atomic Rubric Trees (Omni-ARTs). Each tree contains three dimensions, 23 shared directions, and task-specific atomic binary criteria. The directions test audiovisual grounding, multimodal evidence use, and interactive presentation. Audited Rubric Construction (ARC) builds these trees through independent evidence collection, automated checks, behavioral calibration, and iterative human review. OmniDR-Bench contains 50 Chinese and English tasks across 19 realworld subcategories. It includes 6,414 criteria. Across 18 agent configurations, the best system scores 63.3 out of 100. Current agents still need broader content coverage, stronger causal and logical analysis across modalities, and more accurate citation support. We further analyze models, harnesses, skill configurations, video categories, and research trajectories. The code and data are released at https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench.
hf.titleZh: 超越观看与搜索:面向以视频为中心的深度研究报告的 Agent 基准测试
hf.summaryZh: 针对深度研究 Agent 缺少以源视频为中心的研究评测，提出「以视频为中心的深度研究报告生成」任务:给定视频与用户请求，Agent 需自主提出研究问题、检索外部多模态证据，并产出可交互、可回链到具体视频片段的报告。配套给出基于技能的工作流与 OmniDR-Bench(50 个中英文任务、19 个真实子类、6,414 条标准)，并用 Omni-ARTs 原子评分树从视听接地、多模态证据使用、交互呈现三个维度打分，评分树经独立取证、自动校验与人工迭代的 ARC 流程构建。18 种 Agent 配置中最佳系统仅得 63.3/100，暴露出内容覆盖不足、跨模态因果与逻辑分析薄弱、引用支撑不准等问题。
hf.reason: Agent 深度研究基准，含多模态证据与评分树设计，方法学扎实

hf.title: Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems
hf.abstract: Modern LLM agents can retrieve information from accessible documents, and then disclose a sensitive conclusion assembled from them. This mosaic effect creates a critical risk for agents operating over confidential data. We quantify its realization with 30 synthetic cybersecurity, medical, and military examples, yielding 10,800 final answers from three LLM agents in controlled simulation and 1,440 answers from live agents in two open-source harnesses. Even under benign queries designed to be answerable from one document, GPT-5.6-Sol, the best performing model tested, discloses forbidden composites in 7.08% of answers (95% CI: 3.75-10.67%) in simulation, with worse disclosure rates in live harnesses. Adding visible classification headers and explicit aggregation rules reduces pooled disclosure rates substantially, yet unsafe disclosures persist in 32.37% of simulated answers (95% CI: 28.33-36.19%) across all intents despite these safeguards. Furthermore, increased refusals do not guarantee confidentiality, since significant refusals reveal the prohibited conclusion regardless. These results point to a troubling conclusion: sensitive data leaks via mosaic-style events are an observed confidentiality failure mode in the evaluated settings at non-negligible rates. They motivate stronger controls on what agents may infer and disclose in sensitive data environments with mixed-clearance users.
hf.titleZh: Agent Mosaic：识别 Agentic LLM 系统中的机密泄露
hf.summaryZh: LLM Agent 可从多份可访问文档中检索并拼合出敏感结论（mosaic 效应），在混合权限场景下造成机密泄露。该工作构建 30 个网络安全、医疗、军事合成案例，在受控模拟中由三个 Agent 产生 10,800 条回答，并在两个开源 harness 的真实 Agent 上得到 1,440 条回答。即便查询只需单份文档即可回答，表现最好的 GPT-5.6-Sol 仍有 7.08% 的回答泄露了被禁止的合成结论；加入可见密级标头与显式聚合规则后泄露率明显下降，但各意图下仍有 32.37% 的不安全披露，且拒绝率升高本身也会暴露结论。这说明 mosaic 式泄露是已观测到的机密性失效模式，混合权限环境需对 Agent 的可推断与可披露内容施加更强控制。
hf.reason: Agent 机密泄露的量化评测，属 Agent 安全方向，方法扎实但偏 benchmark

hf.title: RLSplat: Resource-Linear Budget Control for Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
hf.abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (FF3DGS) reconstructs 3D scenes from images in a single forward pass, making it well-suited to applications that must operate within limited resource budgets. To further improve its practicality, recent budget-controllable FF3DGS methods allow the number of Gaussians to be adjusted at inference, so that the output meets a given storage limit or rendering-latency constraint. However, these methods overlook the cost of inference itself: to produce a representation with the target number of Gaussians, they first predict a dense set of Gaussians and then prune or select from it, requiring nearly constant latency and peak memory regardless of the budget. We therefore propose RLSplat, a resource-linear budget-controllable FF3DGS framework whose representation size, inference latency, and peak memory all decrease linearly as the Gaussian budget is reduced. Instead of pruning or selection, RLSplat learns a Gaussian allocation policy that distributes the budget across local scene regions, so that exactly the requested number of Gaussians is generated. These Gaussians are then refined through resource-linear Gaussian decoding, in which each Gaussian attends only to nearby Gaussians found via an efficient hierarchical neighbor search, so that the decoding cost decreases linearly with fewer Gaussians. In zero-shot evaluation, RLSplat outperforms prior budget-controllable methods at every budget, surpassing the strongest baseline even with 4times fewer Gaussians, while running up to 4.1times faster with 9.6times less peak memory at low budgets.
hf.titleZh: RLSplat:面向前馈3D Gaussian Splatting的资源线性预算控制
hf.summaryZh: 前馈3D Gaussian Splatting(FF3DGS)能单次前向重建场景，但现有预算可控方法需先预测稠密高斯再剪枝或筛选，推理延迟与峰值显存几乎不随预算下降。RLSplat改为学习高斯分配策略，把预算分摊到各局部场景区域，直接生成恰好目标数量的高斯;再通过资源线性的高斯解码，令每个高斯只与层次化近邻搜索找到的邻近高斯交互，使解码开销随高斯数量线性下降。零样本评测中，该方法在每个预算档位都优于已有预算可控方法，高斯数少4倍时仍超过最强基线，低预算下推理速度最高快4.1倍、峰值显存降至1/9.6。
hf.reason: 3D Gaussian Splatting重建与渲染，属明确低分方向

hf.title: Is Complex Agentic Memory Always Needed? Naive RAG Is Stronger Than We Thought
hf.abstract: LLM memory is widely used in long-term conversation understanding. Agentic memory systems often use mutation, structural organization, learned retrieval strategies, or other complex operations. Is this complexity always necessary? We study Raw-RAG, a naive RAG baseline using dense retrieval and reranking over raw history to supply evidence to a reader LLM. Across LoCoMo, LongMemEval, MEME, and MemoryAgentBench, Raw-RAG ranks first among the compared memory systems in six of seven benchmark-model settings, outperforming the strongest compared agentic memory system by 0.13-5.53 points. We investigate why raw-history retrieval remains competitive. Evidence analysis shows that its higher coverage of necessary evidence can offset lower utilization. Useful evidence includes both answer values and the relations and dependency paths needed to derive them. Even complete access to transformed memory stores leaves an accuracy gap relative to raw evidence, highlighting the importance of preserving raw information. These findings challenge the necessity of complex agentic memory for the evaluated conversation tasks and establish naive RAG as an essential baseline.
hf.titleZh: 复杂智能体记忆总是必需的吗？朴素 RAG 比我们想象的更强
hf.summaryZh: 检验长期对话理解中复杂智能体记忆的必要性：以 Raw-RAG 为基线，直接用稠密检索加重排从原始历史中取证据交给 reader LLM。在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval、MEME、MemoryAgentBench 上，Raw-RAG 在 7 个基准－模型设定中的 6 个排名第一，比最强智能体记忆系统高 0.13–5.53 分。证据分析显示原始历史检索覆盖的必要证据更全，足以抵消利用率偏低；即便完整访问变换后的记忆库仍与原始证据存在精度差距。该结果对智能体记忆设计的复杂度假设构成直接挑战，也确立朴素 RAG 为必备基线。
hf.reason: 挑战智能体记忆复杂度，涉及 RAG 与 Agent 记忆，结论扎实

hf.title: Cola2: Co-Adaptive Hierarchical Language Modeling with Continuous Semantic Compression and Balanced Discrete Generation
hf.abstract: Hierarchical language generation separates continuous semantic modeling from discrete text realization, but its effectiveness depends on what the latent space compresses and how the discrete generator uses it. We propose Cola2, a framework that jointly studies continuous semantic compression, the balance between reconstruction and generation, and continuous-discrete co-adaptation. Cola2 dynamically segments text into semantic spans, controls the compression rate through auxiliary-loss-free negative feedback, and combines reconstruction and generation supervision to learn compact, predictive latent representations. A block-causal masked diffusion decoder is trained with clean, noisy, and dropped latent conditions, while classifier-free guidance adjusts the balance between semantic reconstruction and autonomous generation. Token-prediction gradients update the encoder through the latents, whereas Flow Matching prior learning is decoupled from representation learning by stop-gradient. During inference, generated text is re-encoded under a fixed span layout to keep the latent history consistent with the actual text context. Experiments on five downstream tasks with about 210 billion training tokens validate the core designs and show competitive, unsaturated scaling. With 346.03 billion source tokens, an unconverged checkpoint reaches a 60.10 average across eight tasks and surpasses Llama-3-8B on HellaSwag and StoryCloze despite its reported pretraining budget being over 43 times larger. These results demonstrate the potential of continuous-latent hierarchical language generation.
hf.titleZh: Cola2:共适应分层语言建模，结合连续语义压缩与均衡离散生成
hf.summaryZh: 分层语言生成把连续语义建模与离散文本实现分离，其效果取决于潜空间压缩了什么、离散生成器又如何使用这些潜表示。Cola2 动态切分语义 span，以无辅助损失的负反馈控制压缩率，并用重建与生成双重监督学到紧凑且可预测的潜表示;解码端采用 block-causal 掩码扩散解码器，在干净、加噪与丢弃三种潜条件下训练，用无分类器引导调节语义重建与自主生成的平衡，token 预测梯度经潜变量回传更新编码器，Flow Matching 先验则以 stop-gradient 与表示学习解耦。推理时按固定 span 布局对已生成文本重新编码，保持潜历史与实际上下文一致。在约 210B 训练 token 的五个下游任务上验证了核心设计并呈未饱和 scaling;346.03B 源 token 下未收敛 checkpoint 在八任务平均 60.10，在 HellaSwag 与 StoryCloze 上超过预训练预算高 43 倍以上的 Llama-3-8B。
hf.reason: 分层潜空间语言建模新架构，预训练规模实验扎实

hf.title: RTAformer: Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer for Video Scene Graph Generation
hf.abstract: Video scene graph generation (VidSGG) aims to capture objects and their evolving relationships in videos. This requires accounting for both the persistence of object identities and abrupt changes in relationships. Existing methods aggregate information across frames to exploit temporal context, but an emphasis on consistency can obscure these changes. As a result, a model may retain its previous prediction even after the underlying relation has changed. We refer to this failure mode as relational semantic inertia. To address this issue, we propose Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer (RTAformer), a one-stage framework that separately models entity persistence and relation changes. It injects calibrated differences between adjacent-frame relation queries to guide predicate updates, while cross-frame instance alignment during training helps reduce cross-frame representational drift. Experiments on Action Genome show improvements in recall and mean recall over existing methods, with ablation studies supporting the contributions of the proposed components and comparisons using matched backbones showing larger gains on relation-transition frames than on non-transition frames.
hf.titleZh: RTAformer:关系变化感知 Transformer 用于视频场景图生成
hf.summaryZh: 视频场景图生成既要跟踪物体身份的持续性，又要捕捉关系的突变，而现有跨帧聚合方法偏重一致性，导致关系已改变后模型仍沿用旧预测，即「关系语义惯性」。RTAformer 采用单阶段框架，把实体持续性与关系变化分开建模:用相邻帧关系查询间的校准差分引导谓词更新，并在训练时引入跨帧实例对齐以抑制表征漂移。在 Action Genome 上召回率与平均召回率均优于现有方法，消融实验支持各组件贡献，匹配主干对比显示关系变化帧上的增益大于非变化帧。
hf.reason: 视频场景图生成属视频理解，与 LLM 方向基本无交集

hf.title: Verus-Insight: Towards Explainable Artifact Detection in AI-Generated Videos
hf.abstract: Recent advances in video generation have made synthetic videos increasingly realistic, placing greater demands on reliable AI-generated video detection. Existing artifact-based detectors typically identify generation artifacts as evidence for source prediction, yet they may either fail to recognize subtle artifacts or reach the correct source decision without faithfully identifying the evidence underlying it. In this work, we systematically investigate how to design and train effective artifact detectors and formulate artifact detection as a structured process comprising three complementary capabilities: Inspection Planning, which determines what should be examined; Evidence Verification, which verifies whether the inspected content exhibits genuine generation artifacts; and Evidence Aggregation, which integrates the verified evidence into the final source decision. Building on this formulation, we introduce Verus-Insight, trained with human-anchored full-process supervision and progressive capability training to strengthen both fine-grained artifact detection and video-level detection. We further introduce Verus-Bench, a benchmark with fine-grained human annotations of perceptible artifacts for evaluating artifact detection. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that Verus-Insight achieves strong performance in both fine-grained artifact analysis and AI-generated video detection, with substantial gains in recovering human-perceived artifacts. Further analyses reveal that the three capabilities are complementary yet distinct, and that Verus-Insight more reliably converts relevant inspection targets into supported artifact evidence without increasing spurious artifact claims.
hf.titleZh: Verus-Insight:迈向AI生成视频的可解释伪影检测
hf.summaryZh: 针对AI生成视频检测中检测器要么漏掉细微伪影、要么判断正确却未忠实指出证据的问题，把伪影检测拆成三个互补能力:检查规划(决定该看什么)、证据核验(判断所检内容是否真含生成伪影)与证据聚合(把核验后的证据汇总为来源判定)，并以人类标注的全流程监督和渐进式能力训练来强化细粒度与视频级检测。同时发布带人类细粒度伪影标注的 Verus-Bench，用于评测伪影检测本身。多基准实验显示该方法在细粒度伪影分析与AI生成视频判别上均表现较强，显著提升对人类可感知伪影的召回，且不增加虚假伪影断言。
hf.reason: 视频伪造检测，与LLM主线仅擦边，方向偏垂直

hf.title: Rethinking Sequence Compression with Test-time Regression
hf.abstract: Sequence compression is a fundamental operation and a critical information bottleneck in efficient language and multimodal models, and yet prevailing approaches based on pooling or learned projections remain underperforming. We revisit sequence compression through the lens of test-time regression: input tokens define a regression problem whose fitted coefficients form the compressed representation. Importantly, the regression problem is learned end-to-end via backpropagation, while its coefficients are computed efficiently in closed form during the forward pass. This leads to TTR-Compressor, a general alternative to conventional pooling and projection-based compression. We evaluate TTR-Compressor as the compressor for block-wise sparse attention and the visual token merger for multimodal large language models. On block-wise sparse attention, TTR-Compressor improves RULER performance over attention-based compressors by a large margin. For visual token merging, it consistently outperforms the standard MLP merger and matches its performance with 55.6% fewer visual tokens. These results establish test-time regression as an effective primitive for sequence compression in efficient language and multimodal models.
hf.titleZh: 重新思考序列压缩：测试时回归视角
hf.summaryZh: 序列压缩是高效语言与多模态模型的关键信息瓶颈，但池化或学习投影等主流方法性能仍不理想。TTR-Compressor从测试时回归视角处理该问题：输入token构成回归问题，拟合系数即压缩表示，回归目标通过反向传播端到端学习，系数在前向中闭式求解。作为块稀疏注意力的压缩器，它在RULER上大幅优于基于注意力的压缩器；作为多模态大模型的视觉token合并器，它稳定超过标准MLP合并器，并在减少55.6%视觉token时达到相当性能。结果表明测试时回归可作为高效语言与多模态模型序列压缩的有效原语。
hf.reason: 序列压缩新范式，命中高效架构与多模态方向

hf.title: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
hf.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can perform a broad range of tasks across diverse settings, yet their performance in agentic contexts remains poorly understood. Although online evaluations in simulators and real-world environments are essential for measuring interactive agent performance, they are costly and challenging to scale. Complementary offline VQA benchmarks can enable faster and more reliable comparisons across agentic domains, yet existing benchmarks remain limited and fragmented. To address this gap, we introduce AgentVQA, an offline benchmark for evaluating VLMs on realistic agentic scenarios across five agent domains: Web Agents, Robotics, Egocentric Videos, Games, and Spatial Planning. We build AgentVQA by manually selecting 1000 challenging, real-world agent examples from 23 source datasets and adapting them for reliable offline evaluation. The resulting benchmark preserves realistic scenarios from interactive environments across diverse domains, and its model rankings track those from corresponding online evaluations. Across the 22 evaluated models, the best achieves only 58.5% accuracy. Our cross-domain analysis shows that errors are driven primarily by failures to ground and maintain accurate representations of the current and evolving visual state, including localizing relevant UI elements, interpreting motion, tracking state changes over time, and inferring 3D spatial relationships, rather than by task misinterpretation or downstream logical reasoning.
hf.titleZh: AgentVQA：统一的智能体视觉理解基准
hf.summaryZh: 在线仿真器与真实环境评测智能体成本高、难以规模化，而现有离线VQA基准碎片化，无法覆盖智能体场景。AgentVQA从23个源数据集中人工挑选1000个高难度真实样本，覆盖Web Agent、机器人、第一人称视频、游戏与空间规划五个领域，构建可离线复现的评测集，其模型排序与对应在线评测一致。评测22个模型，最佳仅58.5%准确率；跨域分析显示错误主要源于无法定位并维持当前及演化中视觉状态的准确表征（UI元素定位、运动理解、时序状态跟踪、3D空间关系推断），而非任务误解或下游逻辑推理。
hf.reason: Agent与多模态理解交叉的评测基准，设计扎实但属基准发布

hf.title: AnyGameRenderer: Entity-Consistent Generative Rendering Across Games and an Entity-Level Benchmark
hf.abstract: AI coding agents can now build small playable games in minutes, but the results usually look like programmer art: gray blockouts, colored geometric primitives, and flat semantic blobs. We present AnyGameRenderer, a video-to-video generative renderer that turns such footage into high-quality visuals with characters, motion detail, and effects. Throughout, it keeps the layout, camera, and every entity's position and timing intact. Our AnyGameRenderer generalizes across a wide range of genres that agents build, such as tower defense, auto-battlers, top-down survivors, turn-based battles, kart racing, and crowd runners. AnyGameRenderer takes plain video as its game-state input, with no complex representations such as engine G-buffers, per-object class labels, or low-poly proxies. Gray blockouts, colored primitives, semantic maps, and wireframes all work as input. It also preserves entity correspondence: group counts stay correct, and entities appear and disappear on the right frame. We implement AnyGameRenderer by LoRA fine-tuning MiniMax-H3 ref2va, a 33B reference-video-conditioned video generation model. Training uses sim10k paired clips from three sources: (i) multi-stream rendering data from 38 agent-made games exported from GEAR, an AI game-creation tool; (ii) two-stream rendering data from Unreal Engine, with programmatically controlled crowds, count changes, and entity scales; and (iii) real gameplay recordings, with pairs reconstructed via 3D-box detection. To evaluate the entity correspondence, we propose an entity-level benchmark of 59 held-out cases with 753 entities, scored against ground-truth boxes. Compared with the base model, AnyGameRenderer better preserves entity correspondence: temporal match rises from 50.9\% to 62.9\%, missed count changes fall from 34.7\% to 21.3\%, and fewer entities are hallucinated or left unrendered.
hf.titleZh: AnyGameRenderer：跨游戏的实体一致性生成式渲染及实体级基准
hf.summaryZh: AI编程智能体能快速产出可玩小游戏，但画面多为灰盒与彩色几何体。AnyGameRenderer以video-to-video生成式渲染将其转为带角色、动作细节与特效的高质量画面，同时保持布局、相机以及每个实体的位置与出现/消失帧不变；输入仅需普通视频，无需G-buffer、逐物体类别标签或低模代理。方法为LoRA微调33B参考视频条件生成模型MiniMax-H3 ref2va，训练用38个AI生成游戏、Unreal Engine受控人群与真实对局构成的sim10k配对片段。配套提出含59个案例、753个实体的实体级基准，时序匹配率由50.9%升至62.9%，漏检数量变化由34.7%降至21.3%。
hf.reason: 视频生成式渲染，属明确低分方向，仅与AI造游戏略沾边

hf.title: MolLean: A Process-Verifiable Language for Chemical Reasoning
hf.abstract: Chemical chain-of-thought can contain hallucinated structural and property claims. We thereby introduce MolLean, a process-verifiable language that grounds chemical reasoning in an explicit molecular state. A layered Lean-based kernel checks state transitions and assertions over molecular readouts, from primitive graph edits to compound transformations. Meanwhile, a typed witness protocol separates native structural checks from externally supplied measurements. We further introduce MolLean-MCP, a stateful tool interface that exposes these transitions, checks, and readouts during generation: the model receives feedback to decide its next action, and rejected actions leave the state unchanged. MolLean supports one-pass trace execution, whole-trace refinement, and interactive reasoning through MolLean-MCP. We evaluate these three modes with direct chain-of-thought on 8,800 matched examples across 12 tasks spanning molecular generation, editing, optimization, and reactions. With Qwen3.6-27B, whole-trace refinement outperforms direct chain-of-thought on all 12 tasks. MolLean-MCP complements whole-trace refinement with stepwise verification feedback, reaching better performance in reaction tasks. Together, these results highlight an executable foundation for chemical reasoning, in which explicit chemical commitments can be checked and revised rather than remaining solely in free-form explanations.
hf.titleZh: MolLean：面向化学推理的过程可验证语言
hf.summaryZh: 化学思维链中的结构与性质断言常有幻觉，且无法逐步核验。MolLean 把化学推理锚定在显式的分子状态上，由分层 Lean 内核检查从基本图编辑到复合变换的状态转移与读数断言，并用类型化见证协议区分原生结构检查与外部测量。配套的 MolLean-MCP 提供有状态工具接口，在生成过程中暴露转移、检查与读数，模型可据反馈决定下一步且被拒动作不改变状态。在 12 类任务、8800 个匹配样例上，Qwen3.6-27B 的整轨迹精修在全部 12 个任务上优于直接思维链，而 MolLean-MCP 在反应类任务上更佳。
hf.reason: 可验证推理与工具反馈机制有新意，但落在化学垂直领域，与主线仅部分交集

hf.title: RIDAR: Safeguarding Research Integrity in Autonomous Research Agents via Automated Detection and Runtime Intervention
hf.abstract: Autonomous research agents are increasingly used to automate large portions of scientific research, yet they are prone to research integrity violations (RIVs): behaviors that compromise the validity, reproducibility, or faithfulness of the research process. We present RIDAR, a framework for automated RIV detection and runtime intervention. First, we introduce RIVT, a comprehensive taxonomy of 14 RIV types spanning the full research lifecycle. Building on RIVT, we present RIDAR-post-hoc, a framework to detect RIVs within agent trajectories. RIDAR-post-hoc achieves 85.2% F1 performance on RIV-Gold, a benchmark for RIV detection with 60 expert-annotated trajectories. Applying RIDAR-post-hoc to RIV-Wild, a dataset of 300 agent trajectories across 50 distinct research tasks, we detect 3,964 RIV instances in 99.7% of trajectories, revealing the prevalence of RIVs in current agents. Finally, we present RIDAR-runtime, a framework for dynamically detecting and correcting RIVs during agent runtime. RIDAR-runtime effectively reduces agent RIVs remaining at task completion by 36.8%. We will release our code and data to facilitate future research.
hf.titleZh: RIDAR:通过自动检测与运行时干预保障自主科研智能体的研究诚信
hf.summaryZh: 自主科研 Agent 常出现损害研究有效性、可复现性与可信度的问题，却缺少系统化检测手段。工作先建立覆盖科研全生命周期的 14 类研究诚信违规(RIV)分类体系 RIVT，并给出轨迹级检测框架 RIDAR-post-hoc，在含 60 条专家标注轨迹的 RIV-Gold 上取得 85.2% F1;随后在 50 个任务、300 条轨迹的 RIV-Wild 中检出 3,964 次违规，涉及 99.7% 的轨迹。进一步提出运行时检测与纠正框架 RIDAR-runtime，将任务完成时残留的 RIV 减少 36.8%，为科研智能体的可靠性监控与干预提供了可复用方案。
hf.reason: 科研 Agent 的运行时监控与干预，命中 Agent 与评测方向

hf.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
hf.abstract: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments. Viewing an observed video as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, we organize the literature around four complementary operations: reading infers world properties from observed video; writing synthesizes video from specified or learned world conditions; sharing integrates understanding and generation through common modeling mechanisms; and interacting predicts and updates world states under actions and evolving observations. This perspective distinguishes temporal coherence in observed or generated sequences from consistency in the underlying world state. Across tasks, representations, models, datasets, and benchmarks, we trace a shift in emphasis from clip-level recognition and perceptual fidelity toward persistent state, controllable evolution, physical and causal validity, and evaluation grounded in interaction and downstream decisions, and we distill the open challenges that follow.
hf.titleZh: 通过视频阅读、书写、共享与交互世界
hf.summaryZh: 将视频视为潜在时序世界的局部、有损、按时序排列的投影，以世界建模为统一视角梳理视频基础模型研究，并划分为四个互补操作：reading 从观测视频推断世界属性，writing 按指定或学到的世界条件合成视频，sharing 用共通建模机制整合理解与生成，interacting 在动作与演化观测下预测并更新世界状态。综述覆盖任务、表示、模型、数据集与基准，指出研究重心正从片段级识别与感知保真度转向持久状态、可控演化、物理与因果有效性，以及以交互和下游决策为依据的评测。
hf.reason: 视频生成与世界模型综述，主要落在视觉生成低分方向

hf.title: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
hf.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is credited with teaching reasoning models to write {wait} before reconsidering a step, yet large RL accuracy gains do not require the word. This view can confuse what RL discovers with what a model inherits from its training data. We trace the word through open models' training histories, reading it with label-free indices of frequency, position, form and usage and an injected-error test, all computed from sampled outputs. We find that zero-RL almost never coins the marker: on bases that lack the word, RL raises MATH-500 accuracy substantially while {wait} stays near absent. It arrives with training data: mid-training in OLMo-3, and fine-tuning on reasoning traces installs it in most models whose base lacks it. Where the base already uses it, both released RL-Zero recipes (OLMo-3, MiMo) multiply it, whereas KL-free GRPO from the same base does not; OLMo-3's recipe wears down its form and makes it a more sensitive but more liberal alarm; RL after supervised fine-tuning barely changes it, and our GRPO recipe erases a marker seeded by fine-tuning. Finally, we show that marker frequency alone does not indicate RL-induced reasoning and caution against LLM-as-a-judge revision metrics, as automated judges can reverse human-labelled trends.
hf.titleZh: 继承而非发明：追溯推理模型中“wait”的来源
hf.summaryZh: 针对“RL 教会推理模型在反思前写 wait”的流行解释，工作沿开放模型训练史追踪该标记，用无标签的频率、位置、形式、用法指标和注入错误测试分析采样输出。结果显示零 RL 几乎不会凭空造出 wait：在缺少该词的基础模型上，RL 可显著提升 MATH-500 准确率而 wait 仍近乎缺席；它主要随训练数据进入（OLMo-3 的 mid-training、推理轨迹微调），已有 wait 的基础模型上不同 RL 配方会放大、磨损或抹除它。标记频率本身不足以指示 RL 诱导的推理，且自动 LLM 评审可能反转人工标注趋势。
hf.reason: 追踪 wait 来源，命中后训练与评估可靠性
